methodology.operation: full check for no-Base workloads; load, fully check, and emit executable JavaScript for Base workloads
methodology.processPolicy: fresh Node process per sample; first compilation; no JIT warmup
methodology.cachePolicy: no persistent Base cache or check-prefix reuse; OS filesystem caches uncontrolled/warm; Node module compile cache disabled
methodology.order: three balanced cyclic orders per workload; serial execution
methodology.timed: imports and compiler pipeline separately; process wall includes startup and output persistence; output execution excluded
methodology.phaseCaveat: Upstream and port phase boundaries differ; attribution only, not equivalent-work phase ratios
methodology.scope: five selected positive workloads; no full-corpus, native/GPU, interpreter, warm-JIT, cached CLI or full-self-rebuild performance claim
